metadata.description: Agent Skills + subagents by @diegofcornejo. Each plugin bundles a skill with its companion subagent so they install (and update) together.

plugins.name: dead-code-hunter
plugins.description: Find and safely remove dead code in JS/TS projects. Skill orchestrates plan/approval/execution; a read-only subagent runs detection in its own context.

plugins.name: deepsec-findings-analyzer
plugins.description: Triage deepsec security scan findings: group by root cause, prioritize, track state across sessions, and draft tickets. A read-only subagent verifies findings against the source code in its own context.

plugins.name: github-security-remediation
plugins.description: Read a repo's GitHub security alerts (Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning), plan and execute prioritized remediation with approvals, and build portfolio reports across owners. A read-only subagent runs the repo analysis in its own context.

plugins.name: random-git
plugins.description: User-invoked git workflows: /random-commit (semantic commits + push) and /random-merge-to-main (merge, push, delete branch).
